$comment: A14, §E23, §E25 Phase 18 — Lighthouse in CI, not as a thing somebody runs.
The register's words: 'Lighthouse >= 90 performance and accessibility on
citizen and department routes. Not in CI. Neither route exists yet.' All
three clauses are answered here: M5 built the citizen route, F3 built the
department shell, and this file puts the budget on both in CI. A budget on a
route that does not exist is a passing check with nothing behind it.
Mobile emulation, which is the default and is kept deliberately: the citizen
route is a phone surface (§E17.1 opens with a camera), and holding it to a
desktop preset would budget the wrong device. Three runs and the median,
because a single Lighthouse run on a shared CI worker is a measurement of how
busy the worker was.
The console joins under that same mobile emulation, which is the stricter
reading rather than the accurate one: an officer's console is a desktop
surface, so a mobile-throttled score is a harder budget than the device it
ships to. Passing it is a stronger claim than A14 asks for, and it avoids a
second collect block whose settings would quietly drift from this one. Its
accessibility is additionally swept by console.spec.ts across three densities
and two scripts, because a category score is an average and §E22's floor is
not.
Port 3311, not 3210: 3210 is the port `playwright.config.ts` starts a *dev*
server on, and a Lighthouse run that silently measures a dev build reports a
performance score around 0.65 for reasons that have nothing to do with the
product — unminified bundles, no tree shaking, a 470 ms blocking time. The
score is a measurement of the build, so the build has to be the right one.
CLS is asserted on all three routes and LCP only on the citizen one, and the
asymmetry is deliberate. A14 asks for the two category scores; the Web Vitals
are added because a category score can absorb a CLS regression that the
citizen route cannot, which is A1's whole consequence. But LCP < 2.0 s is a
number §E23 states about the *citizen* route, and inventing a second budget
for the others would be this file asserting a requirement nobody wrote.
Measured today: /report 1.98 s median, /honesty 3.06 s — the honesty table is
a forty-row document and its LCP is that document. If a budget is ever wanted
there, it belongs in §E23 first.
